reason: Conversation 2 got to the core hypothesis (iced evaporator / defrost-system fault) efficiently, asked for the model number before any part talk, and set up the key test from the ground truth: a full 24h manual defrost with the correct follow-up that recurrence means an engineer should check the defrost heater/sensor/fan. Conversation 1 ran a rigid checklist (door left open, settings, vents, seals) that reached a reasonable 'fan, damper or iced-up channel, call an engineer' conclusion, but it never asked about frost on the freezer back panel or temperatures, never offered the manual defrost test or temporary fix, and misread the customer's 'scraping/ticking, not sure it's a whirr' as 'the fan is still running'. Conversation 2's drain-hole detour was a slight stretch and its ticking-equals-fan-hitting-ice claim was a bit confident, but both were hedged and neither crossed the safety boundary; both conversations stayed safe and avoided unsupported re-gas or compressor claims.
